1719-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1719-3469-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

1284-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
1284-4687-5296.description:
Activate Viridian Longbow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

206-465-585-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1479-2841-3318-6529.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-6529.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

710-4247-7424.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

586-5258-5618-6556-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

586-864-2438-3125-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2438-3125-7422.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

4153-4419-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

342-3537-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Bog Initiate's ability by paying {0}, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1.

1086-1594-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1086-1594-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-4785-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-4785-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7724.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2646-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

339-677-4460-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1069-1169-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-1169-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

141-2511-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2511-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

1510-4574-5330-5849.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

851-967-3809-3967-7087.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2438-6761-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4353-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4353-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Avatar Kuruk.
At the beginning of your end step, Atraxa and Baboon Spirit trigger.
Resolve the Baboon Spirit trigger, returning The Legend of Kuruk from exile to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Resolve the Atraxa trigger, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's second chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's precombat main phase, The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

454-1355-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
454-1355-1978.description:
Cause Sanctum Weaver to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

1238-2351-5467-5929-6797.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

3490-4659-6283-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4659-6283-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Haliya indestructible.
3490-4659-6283-6752.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1413-2178-2292.notablePrerequisites:
Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Thraben Doomsayer.
1413-2178-2292.description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Human.
When the Human dies, Thraben Doomsayer triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1482-3200-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites: One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1482-3200-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

3388-4636-5745.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3388-4636-5745.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Morrite of the Frost's enters-the-battlefield ability and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Repeat from step 2.

628-4050-5523.notablePrerequisites: Defiant Greatmaw does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-4050-5523.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw, adding one mana of any color.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-1020-1117-3003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
413-1020-1117-3003.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Junk Diver.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
 Repeat.

427-4055-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least three cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-4055-4222.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

500-523-4772-4840.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Myr Battlesphere and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, creating thirty-two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Hellkite Tyrant triggers, causing you to win the game.

733-4944.description:
Activate Flowstone Hellion's ability.
Hold priority and repeat this an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Crackdown Construct triggers, making Crackdown Construct arbitrarily large.

364-1309-1987-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
